summary: The payment API experienced gateway timeouts, database connection pool exhaustion, and card gateway circuit breaker openings, resulting in failed and rejected payments. Long-running queries and slow query warnings were also observed on the primary database.

likely_cause.statement: Database connection pool exhaustion and card gateway timeouts may be related to the observed slow queries and long-running database queries, leading to payment failures and circuit breaker trips.

evidence.quote: Unable to acquire DB connection: pool exhausted (waited 3000ms) txn=TXN-40395
Long-running query detected: SELECT * FROM transactions WHERE status='PENDING' (running 212s)
Circuit breaker OPEN for card-gateway (5 failures in 60s)

assumptions: Long-running and slow queries held database connections open longer than usual, contributing to the connection pool exhaustion.
Card gateway timeouts caused the circuit breaker to open, leading to subsequent payment rejections.

missing_information: External status of the card-gateway service during the timeout window
Database server resource utilization (CPU, memory, I/O)

severity.reason: Multiple payment transactions are failing due to database unavailability and gateway circuit breaker rejections, indicating significant core transaction degradation.

troubleshooting_steps.action: Inspect active database queries on db-primary, specifically looking at the long-running pending transactions query.
troubleshooting_steps.why: To identify and terminate blocking or unindexed queries holding up the connection pool.

troubleshooting_steps.action: Check card-gateway upstream health and latency metrics.
troubleshooting_steps.why: To determine if the gateway timeouts are caused by downstream network issues or third-party degradation.

escalation.team: Database Operations and Payment Gateway Integration Team
escalation.when: Immediately, due to ongoing payment failures from database pool exhaustion and open circuit breakers.

incident_summary: Payment processing is degraded due to database connection pool exhaustion and card-gateway timeouts, causing multiple payment failures (TXN-40391, TXN-40395, etc.) and open circuit breakers.
